name: DocRaptor
tagline: HTML-to-PDF and Excel API powered by PrinceXML for print-quality layouts
description: DocRaptor converts HTML/CSS to PDF (via PrinceXML) and Excel. It targets high-fidelity print layouts: headers/footers, page breaks, CSS paged media, and multi-column designs. Developers POST HTML or a URL, choose PDF or XLS, and receive the document as binary or a hosted download. Common in invoices, reports, certificates, and automated document pipelines.

auth.details: HTTP Basic Auth with API key as username and empty password, or api_key query/form field. Key from self-serve dashboard after signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Test mode unlimited (watermarked); free trial with limited production docs — exact counts from pricing page
pricing.paid_plans: Usage-based tiers by document count/month; check docraptor.com/pricing for current plans

example.response_snippet: Binary PDF bytes on success (200). JSON error example: {"errors":["Document failed to render"]}

use_cases: convert HTML invoice template to print-ready PDF
generate multi-page report PDF with headers and page numbers
create Excel spreadsheet from HTML table data
render certificate or letterhead PDF from HTML/CSS
batch convert web page URLs to PDF for archiving
